# Nikita Skliarov-Napriahlo — Full Stack Developer

> Personal portfolio of Nikita Skliarov-Napriahlo, full stack developer at The Freight Hero B.V. in the Netherlands. The site is available in Dutch (default), English, Ukrainian and Russian via ?lang=en|uk|ru.

## Work

- The Freight Hero Platform: multi-tenant freight forwarding SaaS (quoting, 100+ charge-type tariff engine, shipment lifecycle, Dutch VAT logic). https://thefreighthero.nl / https://thefreighthero.com
- Goonys Ticket Portal: multi-tenant ticket system with a browser extension that attaches diagnostics to tickets. https://support.goonys.nl
- Prima Auto's: website for a Dutch automotive business. https://primaautos.nl
- Care of from your Heart: one-page site for an outpatient care provider in Hengelo, built within Goonys. https://careofyh.nl
- Praktijk Monique Hoedemaker: website for a couples and family therapy practice in Hengelo, built and launched together within Goonys. The owner edits her own content in Sanity. https://moniquehoedemaker.com
- Promobo: subscription websites for entrepreneurs and clubs in Twente, run in partnership with Jordi Raanhuis. One fixed monthly price instead of hourly billing, and the site just keeps running. More client cases and collaboration inquiries via https://promobo.nl or info@promobo.nl

## Stack

TypeScript, Angular, React/Next.js, Vue/Nuxt, Node.js, tRPC, PHP/Laravel, Python, C#, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Prisma, Supabase, Docker, Vercel.
